data.gender_notes: Hoskinson is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Greek hoskēinō, 'to save, deliver', derived from hosios, 'holy, good, pious'. In the Old Testament, Hosea is a prophet who calls Israel back to God. The name Hoskinson carries the meaning “Salvation, Deliverance” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Hoskinson usually hope their child will grow to embody salvation, deliverance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name symbolizing God's saving grace and deliverance.
data.etymology: Hoskinson belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Salvation, Deliverance.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hoskinson total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name "Hoskinson" is a Anglicized form of the Greek name Hoskeinos, and carries the meaning of 'savior, deliverer.' Throughout history, bearers of this name have been associated with the idea of salvation and rescue.
data.spiritual_significance: In Christian faith, the name "Hoskinson" can be seen as a reminder of God's saving grace and the spiritual journey of the prophet Hosea in the Old Testament to call his people back to God. It can also be a personal reminder of the call to salvation and the importance of living a holy and pious life. Ultimately, this name carries a deep spiritual meaning, emphasizing God's saving power and the ongoing spiritual journey towards a closer relationship with Him.
